function.name: colgrep
function.description: Search repository code with query alone (semantic search), pattern alone (lexical regex search), or query + pattern (semantic search with regex filtering).

query.description: Optional natural-language query, e.g. "where session token expiry is validated".

k.description: Number of results to return (default 10, max 25).

path.description: Optional subdirectory or file to scope the search.

pattern.description: Optional grep-style regex (colgrep -e). Use with `query` for semantic search with regex filtering, or without `query` for lexical search only. Use for exact names, numbers, or rare terms, e.g. "Art Deco|South Beach". Case-insensitive; if it matches nothing, retry without it.

command.description: Alternative: a full colgrep CLI string.

function.name: terminal
function.description: Run one read-only shell command (ls/cd/cat/head/tail/pwd/grep/find/…). Use colgrep for semantic search.

function.name: finish
function.description: Submit your final answer: the code locations a developer must read and edit. Call this once, when you are done searching. Each location is a string 'path/to/file:START-END': a repository-relative file path and inclusive, 1-based line range (START <= END). Use the exact relevant lines you verified; list separate ranges for disjoint regions.

locations.description: Relevant file:START-END ranges, most important first.
